jobs.description:
What you will do
 

As a Supply Chain Solution Manager for Full Turn Key ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) production within imec.IC-link, you will serve as the critical interface between international customers and our ecosystem of semiconductor foundries, assembly houses, and test facilities. You take up responsibility for the full production, planning and on-time-delivery. This is a new position, to support the growing complexity of our Full Turn Key ASIC programs.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Overall planning related to wafer production, assembly, and test activities. 

• Defining the supply chain flow and managing the official handover of projects from the engineering team to the production team. 

• Monitoring production milestones and ensuring on-time delivery. 

• Aligning with the Production team lead on project status and priorities. 

• Monthly alignment with sales, account managers, and team lead on customer forecasts and subcontractor capacities. 

• Daily follow-up and update of production deliveries using IMEC’s WIP (Work-in-Progress) database system. 

• Reviewing incoming purchase orders from customers and generating corresponding purchase orders for subcontractors. 

• Coordinating global shipments to subcontractors and end customers. 

• Managing complex projects involving dynamic customer rolling forecasts and evolving subcontractor capacities. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field. 

• You bring 5 to 8 years of experience in supply chain operations, preferably in the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry. 

• You are highly organized, accurate, and proactive, with strong skills in production planning, supplier coordination, and customer communication. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting. 

• Diplomatic and with strong communication skills, you engage stakeholders in meeting deadlines, adhering to quality standards and achieving goals within budget. 

• You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and enjoy working closely with engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams. 

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of other languages is a plus.

LLM Engineer | advanced AI & intelligent systems

Are you passionate about transforming cutting-edge AI research into real-world business value?

We're looking for an experienced LLM Engineer to join an innovative AI and Intelligent Systems team driving digital transformation within a highly automated, technology-driven manufacturing environment.

Your impact:

In this role, you'll design, fine-tune, and deploy large language models that automate complex business processes and support critical operations. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders, software engineers, and data specialists to identify high-value opportunities, build proof of concepts, and scale successful solutions into enterprise-grade applications.
Key responsibilities

• Develop, fine-tune, test, and optimize LLMs for production environments

• Design and implement NLP solutions that deliver measurable business impact

• Translate business requirements into scalable AI, data, and software architectures

• Build AI agents, skills, and integrations for modern AI platforms

• Develop MCP servers enabling secure data access and controlled automation

• Lead proof-of-concept initiatives from ideation through implementation

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI capabilities into existing systems

• Contribute to next-generation AI-assisted development workflows using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code

What we're looking for

• Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field

• 7+ years of relevant industry experience

• Strong experience with NLP, LLMs, and transformer-based architectures

• Proficiency in Python and/or C++

• Hands-on expertise with Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Spacy, or similar frameworks

• Experience with Langchain, agentic workflows, and AI application development

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering practices

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with both technical and business stakeholders

• Fluent in Dutch and English

What makes this opportunity unique

This position offers the chance to work at the ForeFront of applied AI, developing solutions that move beyond experimentation and create tangible value at scale. You'll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping AI strategy, driving adoption, and building innovative systems that define the future of intelligent operations.

jobs.occupation: F&B BARTENDER - Jill Hotel Brussels M/W/X
jobs.description:
Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced hospitality professional who wants to do more than simply serve drinks.

As the face of the bar during the evening, you will play a key role in both the operational and strategic development of Jill's F&B experience. You will actively contribute ideas and initiatives to increase revenue, attract local customers and create memorable guest experiences.

You will be part of the strategic thinking behind the evolution and dynamisation of the bar, helping transform it into a true lifestyle destination.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver exceptional and personalized service at the bar.
• Create a warm, welcoming and lively atmosphere for guests.
• Develop sales through natural upselling and product recommendations.
• Animate and energize the bar area while ensuring an outstanding guest experience.
• Contribute to the development of drinks, mocktails and food offerings.
• Promote Jill's Sober Life philosophy and signature products.
• Participate in the organization of afterworks, events and micro-activations.
• Organise, coordinate and manage the weekly Thursday afterworks, ensuring a vibrant atmosphere, excellent guest engagement and smooth event execution.
• Manage daily bar operations, stock levels and service quality.
• Serve the evening food menu, including pasta dishes, sharing boards and other light options.
• Provide room service upon guest request, ensuring timely, professional and courteous delivery of food and beverages.
• Monitor performance and proactively suggest initiatives to increase revenue.
Key Performance Indicator (KPI)

Your primary KPI will be the growth of bar and F&B revenue through:

• Increased average spend per guest.
• Development of local clientele.
• Stronger guest engagement and loyalty.
• Successful activation of the bar and terrace experience.
• Enhanced visibility and attractiveness of Jill's F&B offering. 
Profile

• Minimum 2 years of bartending or bar management experience.
• Previous hotel experience is a strong advantage.
• Passion for hospitality and guest engagement.
• Strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit.
• Ability to create atmosphere and build customer loyalty.
• Creative, proactive and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working independently while contributing to a team environment.
• Interest in lifestyle, design, food & beverage, art and hospitality trends.
• Multilingual: English is mandatory. Other languages are a strong asset.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 

What We Offer

• The opportunity to build and shape a growing F&B concept.
• Active involvement in the strategic development of the bar.
• A creative, human-centered and inspiring work environment.
• A dynamic and entrepreneurial team where ideas are encouraged.
• The chance to make a real impact on the future of Jill's hospitality experience.
At Jill, we're looking for more than a bartender. We're looking for a host, an ambassador, a storyteller and a hospitality entrepreneur who can transform a hotel bar into a vibrant destination.

📍 Brussels, Belgium

📅 Start Date: September 2026

⏳ Initial 12-month contract with extensions possible (up to 3 years)

🕒 Full-time (40 hours/week)

This position is ideal for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys combining hands-on support, troubleshooting, workplace technologies, and user interaction in a fast-paced environment.

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, and workplace-related incidents.

• Customer-focused and service-oriented

• Proactive and willing to take ownership
 
• Analytical and solution-driven
 
• Capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously

Working Environment

jobs.occupation: Asset Modeler IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

At BNP Paribas Fortis, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is where security meets innovation. We're transforming how the bank manages access rights, making it smarter, more secure, and future-proof.

As part of our IAM Evolution Squad, you'll help build a modern, compliance-driven identity framework using SailPoint and CyberArk.

You'll join a 10-person team of Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, and Scrum Master based in Montagne Du Parc.

Here, you won't just maintain security, you'll shape its future.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As our Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the driving force behind designing, implementing, and optimizing our PAM solutions.

You'll ensure our security not only meets the highest standards but also evolves with the future.

 

What will you actually do?

• You'll develop and implement access policies that meet strict security and regulatory requirements. You'll guide the evolution of our IAM systems, working closely with IT and business teams to ensure security never comes at the expense of efficiency.
• You'll share your knowledge and train teams in best practices, because strong security starts with everyone who uses it. And you'll optimize processes using KPIs and continuous improvement because security is never truly "done".
• You'll collaborate with IAM specialists and cross-functional teams (IT Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, Risk) to strengthen our security controls. You'll make sure we're always one step ahead.
 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You have a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and are CISSP-certified (or have equivalent experience).
• You bring 10+ years of security experience, with deep knowledge of PAM (CyberArk) and a strong background in IAM, Segregation of Duties, and Role-Based Access Control. You're familiar with SailPoint and Cloud (IaaS/PaaS).
 

But what really sets you apart? 

• You think strategically and analytically: complexity is a challenge, not a barrier.
• You're persuasive and collaborative: you bring teams together and drive decisions forward.
• You're proactive and resilient: thriving in dynamic environments.
• You work with precision and structure, because quality is non-negotiable.
• And you love working in multicultural teams, because diversity is your strength.
• You speak Dutch & French: because we're based in Belgium.
• You are fluent in English (written & spoken): the language of global security.
• Your toolkit: CyberArk ServiceNow SailPoint Process Management tools – the tools you'll use every day.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
As a Production Support Technician you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

At Michael Page, you'll do much more than recruit. You'll act as a partner for both clients and candidates, helping businesses grow while changing careers and lives. This role offers an exciting combination of talent acquisition, consulting, and business development.

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Omschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• A proactive mindset.
